class PublicConstructor { constructor() {} }
class PrivateConstructor { private constructor() {} }
class ProtectedConstructor { protected constructor() {} }

const privateLast = [PublicConstructor, PrivateConstructor];
const privateFirst = [PrivateConstructor, PublicConstructor];
const protectedLast = [PublicConstructor, ProtectedConstructor];
const protectedFirst = [ProtectedConstructor, PublicConstructor];

new privateLast[1]();
new privateFirst[1]();
new protectedLast[1]();
new protectedFirst[1]();
